newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran expects non-metal exports to rise 70 percent.
newsitem.headline: Iran expects non-metal exports to rise 70 percent.

text.p: Iran expects the value of its exports of non-metal products to rise by almost 70 percent this year to $1.48 billion an Industry Ministry official said.
"The ministry of industries this year expects to export around $1.48 billion in non-metal products," Iran News daily quoted Hussein Naji, head of the ministry's Non-Metal Department (NMD), as saying.
He said the value of Iran's non-metal exports in the last Iranian year, which ended on March 20, 1997, was $877 million.
Naji said projected cement production in the current Iranian year was 22.5 million tonnes, up from last year's 18.5 million.

Production of tyres is projected at 180,000 tonnes this year, from 14,716 tonnes and paper production is forecast to grow to 300,000 tonnes from 256,337 tonnes. He said Iran expects to manufacture 700,000 television sets this year, up from 466,301 last year.
